notes.title: Animated Avatar Frames!
notes.content: We're thrilled to announce that Pomberito now offers two Steam Animated Avatar Frames. We can't wait to see you having fun and customizing your Steam profiles with Pomberito's items!

notes.title: Community Items!
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that starting today, Pomberito has community items!

These are:

- Trading Cards (5)

- Emoticons (5)

- Profile backgrounds (3)

- Badges (5 levels + 1 foil badge)

Thank you all so much for your support and for making this possible!

notes.title: Steam Scream Fest
notes.content: Pomberito will be part of [b]Steam's Scream Fest[/b] starting [b]Monday, October 28[/b], and running until [b]Monday, November 4[/b]. Take advantage of this opportunity and don't miss out on this experience at a record-low price![img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44832571/60d63f072acc0c8cca8dfadff46933e59f24a5b6.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Update!
notes.content:
[h3][u][b]This update includes:[/b][/u][/h3]

- Doubled game's brightness.

- Made subtle changes to the map to make it easier to navigate.

- Fixed the "Catrasca" achievement so it can be unlocked at any given night.

- Improved cuises' hitbox.

- Added a [b]minimap[/b] with [b]hints[/b].

- Improved the broken fence's hitbox.

- Added notes to make the gameplay more intuitive.

Thank you very much for all the support! We'll continue to work on new updates and constantly improve the Pomberito experience based on your feedback!

notes.title: Steam Achievements!
notes.content: We're thrilled to announce that Pomberito will feature seven Steam achievements, just like you asked for. We can't wait to see you having fun and getting spooked with Pomberito as its release draws near. Do you have what it takes to unlock them all?

notes.title: Thank you!
notes.content: Two weeks ago we passed the 10.000 wishlists milestone and now we're just about to hit the 15k mark, thank you very much for all the support!
